title: Interest Rate Buydown Holdings Across Several Loan Files
content:
**Rule.** A customer may hold an Interest Rate Buydown on several loan files; the number of buydowns one customer may hold is unlimited. The limit that applies is the one on what a single loan file may carry.

**Restated.** There is no per-customer maximum for the Interest Rate Buydown. A customer's count of buydowns across all of their loan files is never by itself a reason a buydown cannot be elected; what one loan file carries is limited per loan file.

| Question | Answer under this rule |
|---|---|
| Is there a maximum number of buydowns per customer? | No; it is unlimited. |
| Can one customer hold buydowns on two different loan files? | Yes. |
| What is limited? | What one loan file may carry. |

**Hypothetical case.** A customer of Larkspur Home Lending has a purchase loan file carrying a funded Larkspur 2-1 Temporary Buydown and opens a second loan file for another home. Holding a buydown on the first file sets no per-customer limit on the second; a buydown on the second file is measured only against what that second file carries.
